title: Three New Headlines
instruction: Three headlines for the same article. You have 40 impressions: each tap shows one headline to one reader, who clicks or doesn't. Collect as many clicks as you can.

arms.label: Headline A
arms.text: City council approves new tram line

arms.label: Headline B
arms.text: Your commute is about to change: the new tram line, explained

arms.label: Headline C
arms.text: 5 streets that get a tram stop by 2028

toyNote: Toy click rates, much higher than real ones so that the difference shows within 40 tries. Which headline gets which rate is shuffled every game.
debrief: Exploring costs clicks early but finds the winner; exploiting too soon can lock onto a lucky loser. Thompson sampling explores where it is still uncertain and shifts to the winner as the evidence grows.
